title: Maricopa County Project Baccara Board Action
summary: Maricopa County's official meeting summary records a 4-1 Board vote approving the Project Baccara item and creates a traceable authority milestone upstream of condition compliance and construction.
key_findings: The official summary records the Board motion and 4-1 result.
The action follows the conditional Military Compatibility Permit record.
A separate final air-permit trail exists, but the Board summary is not the fully executed MCP.
why_it_matters: The record establishes a named local decision rather than relying on reported vote coverage, while leaving service, military, water, construction, testing, and occupancy gates open.
ftfn_relevance: Strengthens the local authority chain for a large proposed compute and generation project.
Preserves the distinction between approval and compliance.
evidence_limits: The meeting summary is not the fully executed permit instrument.
It does not prove condition satisfaction, provider commitments, construction authorization, testing, occupancy, or operation.
